'''Grandpa Wolf''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Grandpa Wolf's Cave}} within the {{Zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. He unlocks access to [[Frozen Corpses|Frozen Corpse Milestones]].

== Tips ==
*Players can use {{code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} to access the milestone menu remotely.
*Players should unlock and max [[Heart_of_the_Mountain#Tier_10|Gifts from the Departed perk]] in [[Heart of the Mountain]] before progressing this milestone.

== Trivia ==
*The total cost of keys for maxed Frozen Corpse milestone is {{BZC|100 Umber Key|100 Tungsten Key|20 Skeleton Key}}.
* '''Grandpa Wolf''' is likely related to {{NPCSprite|Grandma Wolf}}.
**Both of them start their dialogue by introducing their respective conundrums to the player.
*The [[German Wolf Skin]] uses the same head as '''Grandpa Wolf'''.
*The {{Code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} command can be used even without access to the {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}}.
